recoveries.reason: Post-run Python decimal oracle NameError on abs; native request completed, but that request had no saved timer/JSON record and is rerun.

interpretation: Same BF16 language weights/protocol; static/cache/backend differences can change greedy text. End-to-end speed includes these changes and cannot be attributed solely to eliminating CPU dispatch.

profiler.granularity: graph; internal kernels/copy nodes are not individually traced

recovery_consistency.note: Reference checking runs after GPU completion. Original unrecorded request had no saved wall timer; the same-token rerun supplies that one measured request. All152 prior rows are retained.
